title: Mischa Zverev: Play the Game Nobody Else Is Playing
description: Former ATP #25 and M22 founder Mischa Zverev beat World #1 Andy Murray with a "dead" strategy—serve-and-volley. He reveals how he disrupted opponents, his comeback from ranking #1,067, the analytics behind unconventional tactics, neuroathletics, working with Alexander Zverev, and why making your opponent play worse matters more than maximizing your own stats. Hosts: Shreyes Sridhara, Adrian Nguyen, Viviana Park, Stefan Perokovic, and Kartik Pandian | Edited by Alp Senay
